# UX/UI principles

Resolve experience decisions from the user's task, observed evidence, and
product constraints. Preserve working conventions and disclose unverified checks.

Read [Change Loop working contract](references/change-loop-handoff.md) before
designing, reviewing, or implementing UX work; it owns task scope, handoffs,
evidence, and authority. Read [experience workflow](references/experience-workflow.md)
for modes and selectively loaded topic/layout guides.

[Upstream provenance](references/upstream.md) pins the source snapshot and
adaptations. Follow the active compiled OpenSpec agreement and harness action;
this skill grants no additional execution or delivery authority.
